description: Central Highlands Water Sewer Sidelines is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Central Highlands Water. Data containing sewer sidelines in the Central Highland Water service area. Please note: Although Central Highlands Water takes great care in managing its data, we make no representations or guarantees as to the accuracy or completeness of this data. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Central Highlands Water. Its tags are CHW_Open_Sewer_Data, network, pipes, sewer. It offers 6 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial No Derivatives 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
